# Blue Heaven Landscape (BHL)

> Landscape design, build and irrigation for resorts, commercial spaces and homes in Tamil Nadu, India. Tagline: "Feel heaven in every breath." Founded by Tamilarasan. 4+ years of work.

Key facts:
- Clients see and approve the design before any work starts.
- Fair price, never cheap work. If a budget cannot pay for good work, BHL says so and helps plan in phases.
- Services: lawns, vertical gardens, living walls, terrace gardens, artificial turf, rock gardens, irrigation (drip and sprinkler), annual landscape maintenance.
- Who we serve: resorts, commercial spaces (offices, IT parks, hotels, schools, apartments, showrooms), homes (villas, terraces, balconies).
- Garden care after handover: available on request (AMC).
- Contact: +91 63806 56237 (call or WhatsApp), hello@blueheavenlandscape.com. Book a consultation: https://blueheavenlandscape.com/book
